description: Generators of the group G of affine maps w -> T w + v of B = F_2^2 + F_3^3 + F_5^2 + F_7^2 (one block per prime), and the affine map c0 = P o (w -> w + g0). G is generated by the translations by the basis vectors of B and by the linear maps a1, a2. The quandle is the orbit of c0 under conjugation by G, with x * y = y x y^-1.
